prompt: What does infrastructure as a service (IaaS) provide?

options.text: A managed platform where the provider handles the operating system and runtime
A fixed, shared desktop for all users
A finished application used through a browser
Virtual machines, storage and networking that you configure and manage above the hardware

explanation: IaaS provides basic building blocks; you manage the operating system and everything above it.

why_wrong.b: That is not a cloud service type.

prompt: What does platform as a service (PaaS) provide?

options.text: An environment to build and run applications without managing servers or the operating system
Physical servers delivered to your office
Raw virtual machines you must patch yourself

explanation: PaaS lets you focus on your application and data while the provider manages the platform.

why_wrong.c: Cloud providers do not deliver physical servers to you.

prompt: What is software as a service (SaaS)?

options.text: A way to buy physical hardware
A virtual machine you install software on
Finished software used over the internet and managed by the provider

explanation: SaaS is complete software delivered as a service, such as Microsoft 365.

prompt: A company wants to move an existing application to Azure without changing it, and it needs a specific operating system configuration. Which service type fits best?
explanation: IaaS gives full control of the operating system, which suits lift-and-shift migration.

why_wrong.d: PaaS manages the operating system for you, so you cannot set it up your own way.
why_wrong.a: SaaS is finished software, not a place to run your own application.
why_wrong.c: Serverless hides the servers, so you cannot control the operating system.

prompt: A development team wants to publish a web app without managing servers or the operating system. Which service type fits best?
explanation: PaaS provides a managed platform so developers focus on code.

why_wrong.b: IaaS would make the team manage the operating system.
why_wrong.c: SaaS is finished software, not a platform for your own app.
why_wrong.d: On-premises hosting is not a cloud service type.

prompt: Staff need email and collaboration tools without installing or maintaining anything. Which service type fits best?
explanation: SaaS delivers ready-to-use software maintained by the provider.

why_wrong.b: IaaS would require building and managing everything yourself.
why_wrong.c: PaaS is for building your own applications.
why_wrong.a: A private datacenter would require buying and running hardware.

prompt: Which service type gives the customer the MOST management responsibility?
explanation: With IaaS you manage the operating system, runtime, applications and data.

why_wrong.d: PaaS gives you less to manage than IaaS.
why_wrong.a: SaaS gives you the least to manage.
why_wrong.b: The service types differ in who manages what.

prompt: Which TWO are examples of SaaS? (Select two.)
explanation: Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 are finished applications delivered as services.

why_wrong.c: Azure Virtual Network is an infrastructure building block.

prompt: Which TWO are examples of PaaS? (Select two.)

options.text: A physical server in your own office

explanation: App Service and Azure SQL Database give you a managed platform for apps and data.

why_wrong.c: A physical server in your office is on-premises, not a cloud service.

prompt: Decide whether each statement is true.

options.text: In IaaS, the customer manages the operating system.
In PaaS, the customer manages the underlying physical servers.
In SaaS, the customer typically manages the hardware.

explanation: The customer manages the operating system in IaaS only; physical servers and hardware are the provider's in all three.

why_wrong.s1: Yes. The operating system is yours in IaaS.
why_wrong.s2: No. The provider always manages physical servers.
why_wrong.s3: No. The provider manages the hardware in SaaS.

prompt: Decide whether each statement is true.

options.text: PaaS lets developers concentrate on their code.
IaaS gives the most control over the operating system configuration.
With SaaS you must install and patch the software yourself.

explanation: PaaS removes platform management and IaaS gives the most control, while SaaS is maintained by the provider.

why_wrong.s1: Yes. The platform is managed for you.
why_wrong.s2: Yes. You manage the operating system in IaaS.
why_wrong.s3: No. The provider maintains SaaS software.

prompt: Which pairing of Azure service and service type is correct?
explanation: Virtual machines are IaaS, App Service and Azure SQL Database are PaaS, and Microsoft 365 is SaaS.
